findings.summary: The persisted-format decimal fallback could misread a grouping comma if localized parsing unexpectedly fails first.
findings.evidence: Locale-aware parsing remains first, the fallback exists only for the canonical persisted decimal representation, and the feature stays compile-time default-off; tighten the parser before user activation.

findings.summary: The exact-archive production-entrypoint runtime enables the test-only financial-plan flag and is not a shipping-default binary proof.
findings.evidence: Runtime metadata explicitly scopes the opt-in to the exact-archive debug proof, while the flag defaults false, is not server-drivable and is separately covered by fail-closed tests.

findings.summary: The technical recovery path remains test-only and delivers no production user value until a separate release decision.
findings.evidence: This is intentional staged rollout: MINT_TEST_FINANCIAL_PLAN_SETUP defaults false and cannot be remotely enabled; BND-06 promotion does not activate it.

findings.summary: The fallback parser could treat a non-standard grouping comma as a decimal separator.
findings.evidence: The localized parser runs first and the fallback repairs canonical persisted decimals; record stricter Swiss input validation before any user-facing activation.

findings.summary: Offline LPP fallback constants labeled 2025/2026 need an explicit OFAS OPP2 2026 source before the retirementLpp branch ships.
findings.evidence: The accepted retirementNoLpp runtime neither consumes nor calculates those LPP constants, the backend sync remains authoritative when available, and the whole feature remains default-off; source verification stays an activation hard floor.

findings.summary: The no-LPP savings target does not state branch-specifically that future AVS income is excluded.
findings.evidence: The generic mandatory disclaimer remains present and no dossier activation is claimed; add explicit AVS-exclusion wording before specialist-facing release.
